goals: Verify that the system sends an automated alert to the user's mobile phone when a potential crop disease is detected and the risk level exceeds the threshold.
Verify that the system sends a preventive notification to the user when an extreme weather event is forecasted and approaching.
activities: Detectar una enfermedad potencial en el sistema
Superar el umbral del nivel de riesgo
Verificar el envío de una alerta al celular del usuario
Simular la proximidad del evento climático
Verificar el envío de una notificación para prevenir daños
